# Neurofeedback Luxembourg — brand and design system

> Public, plain-file copy of the Claude Design System "Neurofeedback Luxembourg" (brand rules, colours, type, logos, photos, recoveriX images, components). Readable by any agent or person without a login. Brand Guide v2.1.3 (approved 2026-10-02) is the rulebook; the brand kit (brand-kit/) carries the same rules as agent instructions.

Read in this order: design-system/README.md (the brand book: voice, slogan, SEO keywords, colours, logo rules, imagery, official accounts), then tokens.json or tokens.css, then the README of the asset group you need. Use the asset files exactly as they are; never redraw the logo.

- Web page (images visible): https://neurofeedback-luxembourg.github.io/brand-guide/design-system/
- Folder on GitHub: https://github.com/Neurofeedback-Luxembourg/brand-guide/tree/main/design-system
- Original (Claude only): https://claude.ai/artifact/EowsRsZbAGGmPPDbLET8k3

## Rules

- [Brand book — design system README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Neurofeedback-Luxembourg/brand-guide/main/design-system/README.md): content rules, main slogan, SEO keywords, visual foundations, logo, imagery, offer, official accounts, components
- [Brand kit — rules for every agent](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Neurofeedback-Luxembourg/brand-guide/main/brand-kit/AGENTS.md)
- [Brand Guide v2.1.3 (full rulebook)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Neurofeedback-Luxembourg/brand-guide/main/brand-kit/brand-guide.md)
- [Business facts](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Neurofeedback-Luxembourg/brand-guide/main/brand-kit/skill/references/business-facts.md)

## Tokens

- [tokens.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Neurofeedback-Luxembourg/brand-guide/main/design-system/tokens.json): 19 colours, type scale, spacing, radii, shadows, each with a usage note
- [tokens.css](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Neurofeedback-Luxembourg/brand-guide/main/design-system/tokens.css): the same as CSS variables (--plum-deep, --space-4, ...)
- [design-system.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Neurofeedback-Luxembourg/brand-guide/main/design-system/design-system.json): index of asset groups and files

## Components (HTML/CSS, prefix nfl-)

- [bundle.css](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Neurofeedback-Luxembourg/brand-guide/main/design-system/components/bundle.css): all component classes; load tokens.css first
- AboutFigure: The expandable "About this figure" / « À propos de ce chiffre » detail: caveats, population, period and the full source with page reference. [guidelines](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Neurofeedback-Luxembourg/brand-guide/main/design-system/components/AboutFigure/README.md) · [preview](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Neurofeedback-Luxembourg/brand-guide/main/design-system/components/AboutFigure/preview.html)
- Button: A single clear action; the primary one is usually the free, non-binding phone call. [guidelines](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Neurofeedback-Luxembourg/brand-guide/main/design-system/components/Button/README.md) · [preview](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Neurofeedback-Luxembourg/brand-guide/main/design-system/components/Button/preview.html)
- Card: A lilac surface that groups one idea: a service, a step, a question. [guidelines](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Neurofeedback-Luxembourg/brand-guide/main/design-system/components/Card/README.md) · [preview](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Neurofeedback-Luxembourg/brand-guide/main/design-system/components/Card/preview.html)
- ChartFrame: A diagram with everything that travels with it: title, share menu, the SVG chart, a one-line takeaway with its source, "About this figure" for method notes, "Show as table" with the data, and the brand line. [guidelines](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Neurofeedback-Luxembourg/brand-guide/main/design-system/components/ChartFrame/README.md) · [preview](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Neurofeedback-Luxembourg/brand-guide/main/design-system/components/ChartFrame/preview.html)
- ClaimTag: The claim-ladder label (Brand Guide §5) on every figure, study and opinion: Fact · Research finding · Our observation · Opinion. [guidelines](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Neurofeedback-Luxembourg/brand-guide/main/design-system/components/ClaimTag/README.md) · [preview](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Neurofeedback-Luxembourg/brand-guide/main/design-system/components/ClaimTag/preview.html)
- Cover:  · [preview](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Neurofeedback-Luxembourg/brand-guide/main/design-system/components/Cover/preview.html)
- DataCallout: A verified number with one short label. [guidelines](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Neurofeedback-Luxembourg/brand-guide/main/design-system/components/DataCallout/README.md) · [preview](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Neurofeedback-Luxembourg/brand-guide/main/design-system/components/DataCallout/preview.html)
- Disclaimer: Required at the end of every health piece (web, social, slides, print). [guidelines](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Neurofeedback-Luxembourg/brand-guide/main/design-system/components/Disclaimer/README.md) · [preview](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Neurofeedback-Luxembourg/brand-guide/main/design-system/components/Disclaimer/preview.html)
- FigureCard: One sourced number as a card: claim tag, share menu, the big number, one confident sentence, a mini-visual, the "About this figure" detail and the brand line. [guidelines](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Neurofeedback-Luxembourg/brand-guide/main/design-system/components/FigureCard/README.md) · [preview](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Neurofeedback-Luxembourg/brand-guide/main/design-system/components/FigureCard/preview.html)
- GuessSlider: "Guess first" on a section's headline figure: the visitor drags a slider (0–100 %), then the real number animates in with the gap to the guess ("You guessed 40%. The real figure is 36%, 4 points lower."). [guidelines](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Neurofeedback-Luxembourg/brand-guide/main/design-system/components/GuessSlider/README.md) · [preview](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Neurofeedback-Luxembourg/brand-guide/main/design-system/components/GuessSlider/preview.html)
- Hero: The page or slide opener: the gradient with white text and the logo badge top-right. [guidelines](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Neurofeedback-Luxembourg/brand-guide/main/design-system/components/Hero/README.md) · [preview](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Neurofeedback-Luxembourg/brand-guide/main/design-system/components/Hero/preview.html)
- LanguageSwitch: Globe icon with "EN · FR"; the current language is highlighted, the other is a link to the same page in that language. [guidelines](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Neurofeedback-Luxembourg/brand-guide/main/design-system/components/LanguageSwitch/README.md) · [preview](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Neurofeedback-Luxembourg/brand-guide/main/design-system/components/LanguageSwitch/preview.html)
- MythStrip: "Myth or number?" / « Idée reçue ou chiffre ? »: a short strip between sections that states a common belief and reveals the answer from a figure already on the page. [guidelines](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Neurofeedback-Luxembourg/brand-guide/main/design-system/components/MythStrip/README.md) · [preview](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Neurofeedback-Luxembourg/brand-guide/main/design-system/components/MythStrip/preview.html)
- ShareMenu: Plain share links on every card and chart: LinkedIn, Facebook, X, WhatsApp, email and "Copy link". No third-party share scripts. [guidelines](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Neurofeedback-Luxembourg/brand-guide/main/design-system/components/ShareMenu/README.md) · [preview](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Neurofeedback-Luxembourg/brand-guide/main/design-system/components/ShareMenu/preview.html)
- SiteFooter: Footer of the statistics site: imprint, address, phone, privacy link and the health disclaimer. [guidelines](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Neurofeedback-Luxembourg/brand-guide/main/design-system/components/SiteFooter/README.md) · [preview](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Neurofeedback-Luxembourg/brand-guide/main/design-system/components/SiteFooter/preview.html)
- SiteHeader: The lean branded header of the statistics site (data.neurofeedback-luxembourg.com): logo, four links to the main site, the free-call button and the language switch. [guidelines](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Neurofeedback-Luxembourg/brand-guide/main/design-system/components/SiteHeader/README.md) · [preview](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Neurofeedback-Luxembourg/brand-guide/main/design-system/components/SiteHeader/preview.html)
- StatusNote: A short state message (form sent, slot full, error). [guidelines](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Neurofeedback-Luxembourg/brand-guide/main/design-system/components/StatusNote/README.md) · [preview](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Neurofeedback-Luxembourg/brand-guide/main/design-system/components/StatusNote/preview.html)
